kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.nama.l: Lao Shuo and the Wooden Block
The Crescent Moon Troupe takes the stage: acrobats and the lion dance!
Lao Shuo raps his wooden block: the tale begins.
Healer Hu Lu shows off his martial art.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.tip.pe: Shift-click a performer to leave a tip.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.bs.bab: Ladies and gentlemen! The Crescent Moon Troupe presents: plates, hoop, human tower, stilts and the lion dance!
Watch the plates spin, do not blink!
A ring of fire? No, sir, an ordinary hoop, but an extraordinary leap!
Three storeys, one breath. Hold, hold!
Stilts as high as a roof; one wrong step and...
The lion is coming! Make way, make way!
Thank you, everyone! Your tips are our wages.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.ls.buk: Sit, sit. Tonight a tale my grandfather heard from his.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.ls.sud: Lao Shuo smiles: you have had today's gift already.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.ls.hal: Lao Shuo slips an old page of notes into your hand.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.ls.pet: Lao Shuo whispers of a hidden place around (%s, %s). It is now on your map.

kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.aq.min: This one I had from my teacher: 'Song Under the Bridge'.
Very well, 'Moon Over the River', for our benefactor.
'Homecoming in Autumn', the song that always makes people quiet.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.ah_qin: I cannot see your face, sir, but I hear your step. A good person's step.
This erhu is older than I am. Its voice is more honest, too.
If anyone knows my teacher's song, please tell me.
Tiger Plaster! One slap and the wound closes!
Thousand Virtues Pill: ten ailments cured, twenty if you are lucky!
Travelling healer, gentlemen! Recipes from three dynasties!
Cloth from the west, tea from the east, jade from everywhere!
A fair price, sir, only a little dearer for the long road.
Only one rare piece today. One!
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.hl.ser: Brothers, behold the healer of three dynasties!
Tiger Palm Descends the Mountain, hyah!
A plank three fingers thick! Look!
I am this strong because of my pills. One for only twelve NB!
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.hl.seh: You are perfectly healthy. Healer Hu shakes his head, disappointed.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.hl.ple: Stick it right here. Tomorrow you will forget the pain!
Tiger Plaster applied (%s NB): you recover a little.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.hl.pil: Swallow it whole, do not chew!
The pill works! You feel refreshed.
The pill is just rice flour. Nothing happens.
Your stomach churns; who knows what that pill was made of.
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.hl.bon: You do not know enough alchemy to expose his pills yet (level 2 needed).
You expose the pill fraud in front of everybody. Good Name +3.
I-I only sell hope, sir! There are no rules about hope!
kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.hl.mit: You do not know enough alchemy to be his partner (level 2 needed).

Your share, partner: %s NB. Our recipe stays secret, yes?

kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.mf.hab: Sold out, sir! Come again the day after tomorrow.

kultivator.kota42.acara.rombongan.su.buk: Blow, beat: who is getting married today?
Long ago a stone on Flower-Fruit Mountain split, and a monkey was born from it.
He became king of the monkeys, learned the seventy-two transformations and rode the clouds.
He wrecked the peach banquet of the Heavenly Palace and stole the pills of immortality.
A hundred thousand heavenly soldiers surrounded him and not one could win.
Only then did the Buddha pin him under a mountain for five hundred years.
Then a monk came, loosed the seal, and the journey to the west began.
So it goes: strength without humility gets locked under a mountain.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.ular_putih: A white snake trained for a thousand years and became a beautiful woman, Bai Suzhen.
By West Lake, in the rain, a young healer, Xu Xian, lent her his umbrella.
They married and opened a pharmacy; she helped many people and asked no pay.
The monk Fahai whispered to Xu Xian: your wife is a demon, give her realgar wine.
Bai Suzhen showed her snake shape; her husband died of fright.
She stole the herb of life from the gods and brought her husband back.
True love does not care about shape; cruelty calls itself holiness.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.penggembal: Niulang the cowherd was poor and owned only an old ox.
The ox said: go to the river, take the clothes of the girl you see bathing.
She was Zhinü, the cloud weaver, the Queen of Heaven's daughter; they married in secret.
The Queen was furious and drew her golden pin; a silver river parted them.
Thousands of magpies flew together and made a bridge in the sky.
Once a year, on the seventh night of the seventh month, they may meet there.
So if it rains on Qixi, those are their tears.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.1: Once ten suns rose together; the fields burned and the rivers dried.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.2: The archer Hou Yi shot nine down and left one for the world.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.3: The Queen Mother of the West rewarded him with a pill of immortality.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.4: His wife Chang'e kept it. The thief Feng Meng came while Yi was away.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.5: Chang'e swallowed the pill to keep it from evil hands and floated upward.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.6: She stopped on the moon with a jade rabbit and an osmanthus tree for company.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.chang_e.ak: Every fifteenth night Yi sets moon cakes on the table, and the moon looks brighter.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.1: The conscription notice came: one man from every family.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.2: Mulan's father was old and sick, her brother still small.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.3: Mulan bought a horse and saddle and rode off disguised as a man.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.4: Twelve years she fought; not one comrade knew.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.5: The Emperor offered her high office; she asked only for a horse to go home.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.6: At home she changed into a woman's clothes; her comrades were astonished.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.mulan.akhi: Two rabbits are hard to tell apart when they run side by side.
Qin Xianglian came leading two small children and beat the petition drum.
Her husband Chen Shimei, now the Emperor's son-in-law, denied them.
Judge Bao asked gently, but Chen lied boldly.
The assassin Chen sent gave himself up: he could not kill so sincere a mother.
The Princess begged mercy for her husband; Judge Bao did not budge.
He prepared three executioner's blades: for officials, nobles and commoners.
The same law for all, so that the people dare to complain.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.delapan_de: Eight immortals were invited to the peach banquet and chose to cross the eastern sea.
Each crossed by his own gift, with no boat.
Li Tieguai threw down his iron crutch; He Xiangu rode a lotus flower.
The Dragon King kidnapped a young immortal for the treasure in his robe.
The other seven fought; the sea heaved until the Buddha came to part them.
They went home unhurt; the Dragon King apologised and paid damages.
Hence the proverb: each shows his own gift.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.1: In the north lived Yu Gong, ninety years old, his house blocked by two mountains.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.2: He told his children and grandchildren: let us dig these mountains away so the road opens.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.3: The Wise Man laughed: you cannot even pull one blade of grass from them.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.4: Yu Gong answered: when I die there is my son; when he dies, my grandson. The mountains grow no taller.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.5: The mountain gods grew afraid and complained to the Heavenly Emperor.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.6: The Emperor was moved and sent two gods to carry the mountains away.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.yu_gong.ak: Perseverance passed down is heavier than any mountain.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.sarjana_ru: A poor scholar lived in an old temple, studying each night by a candle stub.
One night a beautiful girl knocked: your lamp is bright, may I read with you?
She and her sister were trained foxes; they wove, cooked and kept him company.
The scholar passed the examination with their help, but forgot his promise.
When he married an official's daughter, the fox girl left without a word.
Years later he found a pair of small slippers under his pillow.
Some kindnesses are never collected; the one who forgets them is the poorer.
Zhu Yingtai dressed as a man to go to school and met Liang Shanbo.
They swore brotherhood and shared a room three years; Liang never suspected.
On leaving, Yingtai hinted ten times, and Liang did not understand.
When Liang came to propose, Yingtai was already promised to a rich family.
Liang fell ill and died; on her wedding day Yingtai stopped at his grave.
The grave split open; she leapt in, and two butterflies flew out.
The butterflies still fly in pairs in the gardens of spring.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.penjara_ib: Under the eastern mountain there is a prison that was locked a thousand years ago.
The ancients put the hardest demons there, one on each layer.
Five formation masters laid the seal; each kept one key.
The keys were scattered; some are kept in temples, some in tombs.
City folk say that on a quiet night you can hear something knocking from below.
That is why demon hunters always stop here before they climb.
I am old, child. If you ever find one of the keys, do not announce it.
kultivator.kota42.acara.kisah.sekte_awan: There was once a sect with no land: their mountain drifted among the clouds.
They came down only once every hundred years to choose disciples.
That day was called Cloud Descent Day; every child with a root gathered in the square.
Whoever smiled without fear when the cloud touched his face was the one chosen.
A chosen disciple never came back, except as a teacher, a hundred years on.
They say there is a stair in the sky where they climb; it shows only in a wet dawn.
If one morning the mist feels warm on your face, do not run, child. Smile.

kultivator.kota42.acara.wayang.kera_sakt: Honoured guests, tonight's shadow play: the Monkey King and the journey west!
The monk leads the white horse west in search of the holy books.
Wukong cuts down the white-bone demon disguised as a girl.
Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing bicker over the food, as usual.
Master and disciple bow to each other; the road is still long.
Three times Wukong was sent away, three times he came back.
For loyalty is mightier than seventy-two transformations.
Thank you, everyone. Your applause is the dalang's wage.
kultivator.kota42.acara.wayang.ular_puti: Honoured guests, tonight the tale of two snakes and a healer!
Bai Suzhen meets Xu Xian under an umbrella as the rain falls.
The two snake sisters follow West Lake toward the city.
Fahai fights Xiaoqing on the broken bridge.
Fahai chases Bai Suzhen to the foot of Leifeng Pagoda.
The lake rises with tears, and the pagoda covers her.
Yet that love does not die; it waits beneath the tower.
Thank you, everyone. Walk home carefully; the streets are wet.
kultivator.kota42.acara.wayang.hua_mulan: Honoured guests, tonight a daughter and a call to war!
Mulan weaves while her father reads the call-up letter.
She rides out of town and changes her clothes in the forest.
She challenges the enemy chief and knocks the spear from his hand.
She bows before the general; not one of them knows.
Twelve winters she passed, without one complaint.
Her horse carries her home to a loom still warm.
Thank you, everyone. May you all come home safe.
kultivator.kota42.acara.wayang.hakim_bao: Honoured guests, tonight a court from behind the curtain!
Qin Xianglian beats the petition drum before the yamen.
Zhan Zhao chases Chen Shimei's messenger through the night.
Judge Bao stares at Chen: not even the Emperor's son-in-law is an exception.
Two officials bow: a court weighs, it does not flatter.
The three executioner's blades are carried to the middle of the hall.
The verdict falls; no one dares to speak.
Thank you, everyone. A just law is rare; that is why we clap.
